title: Born next to the Army's first nuclear test reactor

tellings.quote: reactor that the Army had spun up uh and

plain: John Blitch, a former military scientist who says he was taken by an alien, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he grew up in Idaho Falls, Idaho, in the late 1950s and early 1960s. He says he was born next to a nuclear test reactor the Army had started up there. He tells it as part of his life story, and it would place him near nuclear sites from his very first years.
